hooks.logic:
Count up "turnInCurrState".
Let suffixNoByParamId be the enemy → get-suffix-no-by-param-id with (the enemy → get-current-param-id).
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
Let abilityTagList be aiArg → get-ability-tag-list with ("ability_tags_of_change_defense_mode").
Let ability be the id of the move labelled abilityTagList on the enemy.
If suffixNoByParamId is "1" and the HP fraction of the enemy is at most the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_phase_2" in aiArg, then
  The enemy cancels its cast.
  The enemy changes to stat block the stat block of form "3" on the enemy and stop.
Otherwise, if suffixNoByParamId is "2" and the HP fraction of the enemy is at most the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_phase_2" in aiArg, then
  The enemy cancels its cast.
  The enemy changes to stat block the stat block of form "4" on the enemy and stop.
Otherwise, if suffixNoByParamId is "1" and condition flag "ability_done" is up this frame and ability contains the value "abilityId" of the last move of the enemy, then
  The enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{deformTag: "deformation_01"}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
  Reset the count "turnInCurrState".
  The enemy cancels its cast.
  The enemy changes to stat block the stat block of form "2" on the enemy and stop.
Otherwise, if suffixNoByParamId is "3" and condition flag "ability_done" is up this frame and ability contains the value "abilityId" of the last move of the enemy, then
  The enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{deformTag: "deformation_01"}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
  Reset the count "turnInCurrState".
  The enemy cancels its cast.
  The enemy changes to stat block the stat block of form "4" on the enemy and stop.
Otherwise, if suffixNoByParamId is "2" and the numeric entry "turn_count_for_change_to_defense_phase_1" in aiArg is less than the count "turnInCurrState", then
  The enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{deformTag: "deformation_02"}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
  Reset the count "turnInCurrState".
  The enemy cancels its cast.
  The enemy changes to stat block the stat block of form "1" on the enemy and stop.
Otherwise, if suffixNoByParamId is "4" and the numeric entry "turn_count_for_change_to_defense_phase_2" in aiArg is less than the count "turnInCurrState", then
  The enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{deformTag: "deformation_02"}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
  Reset the count "turnInCurrState".
  The enemy cancels its cast.
  The enemy changes to stat block the stat block of form "3" on the enemy and stop.
Otherwise
  If the enemy is ready to act, then the enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
  Stop.
